note: Hand-tuned home views. Used instead of a clip's own view.json (4DV's suggested camera) where that one frames badly. pivot = point to orbit (Unity metres), yaw/pitch in degrees, height = metres of scene shown top to bottom. Find values with: "4DV Viewer.exe" -4dv-clip N -4dv-pivot x y z -4dv-yaw deg -4dv-pitch deg -4dv-height m
